[ASSISTANT_SAID] Silence can be used in film sound design to create tension and suspense by withholding sound.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Silence can highlight dramatic moments, such as a character's realization or a dramatic reveal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Silence can contrast with loud sounds, making them more impactful by providing a moment of silence before or after.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Silence can convey a sense of isolation, emphasizing a character's solitude.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Silence can emphasize the natural environment by highlighting natural sounds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Silence can create ambiguity or uncertainty in a scene.
